headline: How to Price After Payment Fees
description: Reverse the fee formula so invoices still net what you need after Stripe, PayPal, Square, or creator fees—including how much to charge to receive $100.

itemListElement.name: How to Price After Payment Fees

mainEntity.name: Should I show fees as a surcharge on the invoice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Card-network and local rules restrict surcharging in many jurisdictions. Building fees into the list price is usually simpler than adding a checkout surcharge. When you do disclose a fee pass-through, confirm it is allowed for your location, card brands, and processor agreement—and still run reverse math so the net lands correctly.

mainEntity.name: Do creator platforms use the same reverse formula?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for planning. You still solve charge = (net + fixed) ÷ (1 − percent) when the take is a percent plus fixed. Blended platform-plus-processing estimates (Patreon, Gumroad, Ko-fi) may differ from exact invoice lines, so treat calculator output as a planning figure and spot-check against a real payout.

mainEntity.name: What if my processor gave me custom pricing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the closest public schedule, then substitute your contracted percent and fixed fee in the same formula. Custom rates often beat published list rates. Keep the contract PDF and the date you verified the rate next to your rate card.

mainEntity.name: Do these numbers include sales tax?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Tax collection is separate from processor fees. Decide whether tax is added on top of a fee-inclusive price or absorbed, then re-run reverse mode so post-fee net still matches your target.

mainEntity.name: How much should I charge to receive exactly $100?

acceptedAnswer.text: Approximate US list figures as of 2026-10-24: Stripe ≈ $103.30; PayPal G&S ≈ $103.08; PayPal Checkout ≈ $104.14; Square Plus/API online ≈ $103.30; Free-plan online is higher. Confirm in each calculator and on official pricing pages before you publish.

mainEntity.name: Can I bookmark a pre-filled calculator?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Share links can include mode, rate, and amount. Canonical tags still point at the clean tool URL for SEO, while the query string helps teammates reproduce the quote.
